about: Chinese silver shops (银楼): every shop in the province-by-province lists of Chen Zhigao 陈志高, 中国银楼与银器 (Tsinghua University Press, 2015), regional volumes 华北东北, 华东 and 华中华南西南西北: name, address, manager, the year the shop opened or was first recorded, Chen's notes, Chen's source codes (decoded where the scan reads them unambiguously), and the marks Chen photographed on objects. Read by machine (macOS Vision) from the scans; research files in hallmark-sources/chinese/yinlou.
